page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 32 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, supported by 256.0 GB of system memory, which provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1436.69 and a multi-core score of 30656.07, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 11147.0. Memory subsystem performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1704.61 GB/sec, dropping to 112.52 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write bandwidth of 49.63 GB/sec. For database and key-value operations, the instance demonstrates strong throughput, processing 28.86 million Redis SET operations per second and scoring 11530.5 on PassMark database operations.

Lacking local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, the ecs.hfr6.8xlarge relies entirely on network-attached storage and CPU-based execution. This design prioritizes memory density and compute predictability over local I/O speed or hardware-accelerated parallel processing, making it a cost-efficient choice for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-speed local scratch space. The instance is well-suited for in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise database operations, and moderate-scale data processing tasks.
